# An action reading more than one thing gets a mutant per combination of
# its operands, so a test that watches the rendered result without
# depending on all of it is shown which parts nothing is watching.
#
# Emptying the whole action says only that something about it matters.
# Replacing .First alone, .Last alone, and both together says which.
#
# The substituted values are drawn from a seeded generator, so --seed 1
# gives the same report every time. Without --seed one is drawn and
# printed, so any run can be repeated.

muxt test-template-mutations --dry-run --seed 1
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}{{printf "%s-%s" .First .Last}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	First string
	Last  string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPage(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, Page{First: "a", Last: "b"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "a-b"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("page = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want.txt --
